vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: The two images named here are the 3.0.0 and 3.1.0 index digests, the same on both registries. Their binaries carry golang.org/x/crypto for golang.org/x/crypto/hkdf alone and link no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package, so neither contains the code the advisory is about. Releases from 3.2.0 on do not carry the module at all. The source tree is no longer a product of this statement: golang.org/x/crypto v0.59.0, which go.mod requires from 2026-11-14, no longer contains openpgp and is past the version the Go vulnerability database names as the fix, so no scan of the tree reports the advisory.
statements.status_notes: Held by make check-vex (cmd/audit_vex), which runs the same source scan as make govulncheck and reads go.mod beside it, and fails when what a statement says of the module names an advisory the dependency set no longer contains, when the scan finds the advisory's packages imported or its functions called, or when the scan reports an advisory that does not affect the code and no statement accounts for it. The image products describe published images, which do not change, and stay for as long as those images are published.
